question.general_feedback:
Saprophytes and their food sources:

Saprophytes are organisms that feed on dead and decaying organic matter by secreting digestive enzymes and absorbing the products.

SaprophyteFood Source
1Mucor (bread mould fungus)Bread / decaying organic material
2Rhizopus (black bread mould)Bread / decaying fruits/vegetables

Other valid examples:

  • Aspergillus — decaying organic matter, stored grain
  • Penicillium — decaying fruits (blue/green mould)
  • Putrefying bacteria (e.g. Bacillus, Clostridium) — dead animals/plants

steps.label:
Saprophyte: an organism that feeds on dead/decaying organic matter (extracellular digestion)
Examples: Fungi (Mucor, Rhizopus, Aspergillus, Penicillium) | Bacteria (Bacillus, Pseudomonas)
